messages:
Alex S: Heads-up — I'm preparing a per-customer rollout plan for the new `adaptive-batching` toggle. Need quick alignment on allowlist/contract gating & VIP rules. TL;DR: VIPs handled separately, all others follow percentage canary plus contract-flag check.

Priya K: +1. Do we have a canonical field on the contract object to drive this? thinking `features.allowed` or `feature_gates` map.

Marco T: We already have `contract.features` in billing DB. It's a JSON map w/ feature keys. The tricky bit is ensuring it's checked at evaluation time (not just during onboarding).

Linda (PM): Scope: Enterprise customers can opt-in via contract, but some VIP customers (e.g., AcmeCorp, BetaPartners) get soft opt-in for internal testing. For prod we require explicit allowlist unless listed as VIP in the VIP table.

Ben O: Quick checklist I want: 1) API to toggle per-customer (`ff-config` service) 2) CLI command for ops 3) guardrail alerts 4) QA canary list + smoke tests.

Alex S: Proposed rollout policy: non-VIP customers: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 24/48h windows. Enterprise customers with `contract.features.adaptive-batching: true` get immediate enable. VIPs: enable in staging + opt-in beta in prod by adding to `vip_customers` table.

Priya K: Guardrails: auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% OR p50 latency increases > 20ms for 5m window. Also block if token-cost/sample increases > 15% compared to baseline. We should implement these in the rollout controller.

Marco T: Implementation notes: ff-config supports per-customer key already. We need to update evaluation path to check (1) customer_id in vip_table && env != prod -> feature ON for testing, (2) else check contract.features map, (3) else percentage rollout flag. Pseudocode:

```
if (isVip(customer_id) && env != 'prod') return true;
if (contract.features['adaptive-batching'] === true) return true;
return rolloutPerc(customer_id, 'adaptive-batching') <= n;
```

Ben O: Ops CLI for quick toggles (draft):

```
# enable for one customer
rfctl feature set adaptive-batching --customer=acct_1234 --enabled=true
# add to vip table
rfctl vip add acct_1234 --reason="beta request"
```

featureflag-bot: ff-config: created toggle `adaptive-batching` (id: afb_20260317). Current global rollout: 0% (admin-created).

Priya K: QA: we'll provide an allowlist CSV for the first canary wave (10 customers) + a separate VIP test lane. QA Team will run smoke scripts and perf harness. Need PR with test fixtures.

QA Team: We'll need a sandbox with 10% traffic routing to validate KVs and batching behavior. Also add synthetic traffic for latency regression.

Alex S: Code PR ready at https://phab.redwood/PR/2356 — changes: ff evaluation order, new CLI bindings, docs update. Marco & Ben can you review? Also add migration to populate `contract.features` for existing customers who signed contract addenda.

Marco T: Reviewing now. Note: migration should be idempotent — use `CONTRACTS.features->'adaptive-batching'` default false. Also make sure the feature check caches results for 60s to avoid DB explosion.

Ben O: Ops checklist for rollout day: 1) create canary allowlist in ff-config 2) preflight run (smoke + perf) 3) enable 1% global + monitor 4) escalate to 10% if green 5) run migration in low-traffic window if needed 6) update SLO dashboards. I'll own runbook.

Linda (PM): Expose a quick table in console showing per-customer status (enabled/disabled/source: VIP|contract|rollout). UX ticket created: #UI-442.

Alex S: Quick question: who can flip contract-based gates? We want only CM or legal changes to trigger production auto-enable. Suggest: writes to `contract.features` require CLA-signed flag & approvals pipeline.

Priya K: Agreed. Only the billing service with appropriate role should update `contract.features`. CLI and ff-config can be used by eng/ops for temporary testing but must be audited and time-limited.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: alert — featureflag-service v3.4 deployed to staging at 1773005120 by ci/cd.

Marco T: Also adding automatic rollback rule in rollout controller: if guardrail tripped, set rollout to 0% and mark `last_rollback_by=controller`, send page to #eng-oncall. PR will include that logic.

Alex S: Final asks: Marco + Ben review PR 2356, Priya finalize guardrail thresholds in the controller config, Linda coordinate with legal on the contract field gating, QA to provide initial canary CSV by EOD. I'll stage the runbook in the ops-runbooks repo.

Priya K: I'll post the guardrail config in a follow-up message. :thumbsup:

Ben O: Pinged on PR. If no blockers I'll merge and schedule the 1% canary for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :calendar:

Alex S: Thanks all — tagging for visibility: @Linda (PM) @Marco T @Ben O @QA Team.
